text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear,
oh dear. Who might be calling for 
the Saintess?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Great Three Goddesses, it was you 
all along!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am honored.
Do you require salvation? Or 
perhaps... are you bestowing an ordeal 
upon me?
